name: BXH TokenStakingPoolDelegate pays USDT bonus at the live BXH/USDT spot quote
summary: TokenStakingPoolDelegate converts a staker's pending BXH reward into the pool's USDT bonus token with getITokenBonusAmount, which applies the constant-product formula to the BXH/USDT pair's live getReserves and pays the result from the contract's USDT balance. The attacker flash-borrowed 3.18M USDT, bought BXH to inflate the pair's USDT per BXH, then harvested about 15 BXH of pending reward from a prior vUSDT stake as 40,085.62 USDT, draining the bonus balance.
notes: Admin Safe 0x445b0ad0c36fc0f0f3f51821d21a63701c821426 called add() creating pool 0 (vUSDT) with enableBonus=true, bonusToken USDT and swapPairAddress set to the BXH/USDT pair 0x919964b7f12a742e3d33176d7af9094ea4152e6f (PoolAdded log 205). Without an enabled bonus pool the spot-quote conversion path is unreachable.

Net USDT depletion of the staking contract in the anchor: 40,085.623577085020521681 USDT paid out minus the 200 USDT the attack contract sent in first so the balance covered the payout. USDT (BSC-peg) valued at par. The honest value of the harvested reward at the pre-attack reserve ratio was about 2.6 USDT and is not deducted. The PancakeSwap flash-loan fee and the round-trip swap cost are attacker costs and are not netted.
